rows.quote: Specifically, these data were represented by the following FinnGen identifiers: vitamin D deficiency (finn-b-E4_VIT_D_DEF), cancer (finn-b-C3_CANCER), and diabetes (finn-b-E4_DIABETES).
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the FinnGen data by OpenGWAS accessions (finn-b-E4_VIT_D_DEF, finn-b-C3_CANCER, finn-b-E4_DIABETES); no dictionary row lists a finn-b accession and no release number is written (rule B).

rows.quote: These GWAS data can also be retrieved from the IEU Open GWAS repository, under accession code ieu-b-4980, which covers a population of 486,484 participants, including 11,643 sepsis cases.
rows.coder_note: The sepsis GWAS is named by OpenGWAS accession ieu-b-4980, which no dictionary row lists and which is outside the ukb-b/ukb-d range (rule B); the two count pairs (26,052/487,214 and 11,643 of 486,484) match no dictionary row, so neither is a conflict under rule H; reference 14 is the general UK Biobank resource paper.

rows.quote: The data used in this study come from the plasma protein pQTL data of the deCODE database version 2021,4 which describes a GWAS study of 35,559 Europeans that measured plasma protein levels using 4907 aptamers; (the pQTL instrumental variables included in the analysis are provided in the appendix pQTL_drug_exposure.txt; 10.5281/zenodo.17283362).
rows.coder_note: The sentence states the data used are deCODE version 2021 with exactly 35,559 participants and 4907 aptamers, which matches only the Ferkingstad 2021 row (Eldjarn is 35,892); the earlier 54,219 UK Biobank participants / 2923 proteins description exactly identifies no dictionary row, so it is not a conflict under rule H; linked reference 4 is an unrelated paper and is not used.
